seo.title: Merge PDF Files Online — Free & Secure | JPdf
seo.description: Combine multiple PDF files into one in seconds. Free, fast, and private — no installation required.

subtitle: Combine multiple PDFs into a single document in the order you choose.

howItWorks.title: How to merge PDF files
steps: Upload two or more PDF files.
Drag them, or use the arrow buttons, to set the order you want.
Click Start and download your combined PDF.

items.a: Yes, merging PDFs is free within the daily usage limits shown above.

items.q: Will my files be kept private?
items.a: Yes. Files are processed securely and automatically deleted after a short retention period.

items.q: Is there a limit to how many files I can merge?
items.a: Guests can merge up to 10 files per job; registered users can merge up to 20.
